claims.scope: CLOB order book limit-per-side enforcement when adding a new order that introduces a new price limit queue

preconditions.text: The worst price limit queue contains more than one order.; The new order being added introduces a new limit/price queue.; maxNumLimitsPerSide is the bound from which non-competitive orders should be removed upon adding new orders.

evidence: Clob orderBooks have a `maxNumLimitsPerSide` from which on addition of new orders, the non competive orders should be removed. But the contract makes an assumption that there will be only one order in the worst price limit queue.

For cases where the worst price limit queue has more than one order, the limit will not be removed and if the new order being added introduces a new limit/price queue, the `maxNumLimitsPerSide` variable will be exceeded and the check  of `ds.askTree.size() == maxNumLimitsPerSide)` will return false hence the least competitive price order will not be removed from the orderBook while it should be.
